lines.t: You remember the Sabbath, and I remember you,
You bless this holy day, and I pour blessings through.
You lay down your labor, leave the world outside,
You rest in My presence, in My peace you abide.
For I am the Lord, Maker of earth and sky,
I fashioned all creation, then I rested high.
Shabbat Shalom, I am calling you to rest,
Six days you have labored, now the seventh day is blessed.
Shabbat Shalom, let your worries fall away,
You remember the Sabbath, and I remember you today.
You put away your works, let the clamor cease,
You turn your heart toward Me, in wonder and in peace.
Your thoughts dwell upon your God and saving King,
In awe of all My works, you lift your voice and sing.
For I am the Lord, who made the stars above,
I draw you to My table with everlasting love.
Shabbat Shalom, I am calling you to rest,
Six days you have labored, now the seventh day is blessed.
Shabbat Shalom, let your worries fall away,
You remember the Sabbath, and I remember you today.
You bear your cross for six long days,
But on the seventh, let Me raise
The weight you carried, the heavy load,
I lift it from you on this holy road.
So you rejoice and you are glad,
For this is My will, that your heart be made glad.
You lay your cares down, I lift you up,
You come to My Sabbath, I overflow your cup.
You choose My rest, I surround you with My light,
You honor this day, and I hold you through the night.
Shabbat Shalom, I am calling you to rest,
Six days you have labored, now the seventh day is blessed.
Shabbat Shalom, let your fears be swept away,
You remember the Sabbath, and I remember you today.
Shabbat Shalom, let your praises rise above,
For this is My will for you: rejoice in My love.
